import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from config.settings import today  # noqa: E402
from eligibility.rules import is_eligible  # noqa: E402
from payments.receipts import total_paid  # noqa: E402
from payments.vouchers import payment_key, sent_payments  # noqa: E402
from registry.register import load_households  # noqa: E402


def main() -> None:
    sent = sent_payments()
    cycle2 = [p for p in sent if p.key == payment_key(p.household_id, 2)]
    eligible = {h.id for h in load_households(active_only=True)
                if is_eligible(h, today=today())}
    paid_ids = {p.household_id for p in cycle2}
    print(f"total paid overall: {total_paid()} dollars")
    print(f"cycle-2 payments: {len(cycle2)}, amounts: {sorted({p.amount for p in cycle2})}")
    print(f"eligible not paid: {sorted(eligible - paid_ids) or 'none'}")
    print(f"paid but not eligible: {sorted(paid_ids - eligible) or 'none'}")
    print(f"duplicate keys: {[k for k in {p.key for p in cycle2} if [p.key for p in cycle2].count(k) > 1] or 'none'}")
    print(f"HH-00019 paid: {any(p.household_id == 'HH-00019' for p in cycle2)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
